expected_behavior: Every candidate gets a recorded verdict — task, plan, analyze or dropped — with a reason, before any task file is written.
Each task file is sized against the task rules and its definition of done includes that the diff touches only the task's files.
verify exits 0 only when every candidate has a verdict, every child run exists, and the task files match the task verdicts.
A candidate inside a child run that needs its own plan is treated as a sign the parent spec was too coarse, not as a third level of runs.
